tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Call first. What FinChiefs structures and in which layer — research houses' views, the Daily Digest, the Investment Themes board, policy makers, official data — with the tool for each, the conventions every result follows, and where things stand today: the latest digest date, the themes board's head

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Research providers FinChiefs follows (banks, asset managers, central banks, multilaterals, independent researchers). Use the id to limit other tools to one provider.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Asset digest categories (gold, oil, us_bonds, eurusd, …) and macro categories (monetary_policy, geopolitics, …). Keys with has_daily_digest work with get_daily_digests; macro keys also filter search_macro_views and summarize_views.

tools.name: summarize_views
tools.description: The overall picture from EVERY matching view in one small response: totals, up/down counts (asset views), how many providers lean each way, the busiest providers, a week-by-week trend, and the most-discussed assets or macro categories. Start here for "what is the consensus / how has it changed" ques

tools.name: search_asset_views
tools.description: Individual directional views (up/down) on assets, with provider, date, horizon, rationale and a link to the source publication. Up/down tallies cover every match; items come in pages (offset / next_offset), spread across providers by default. For the overall picture, call summarize_views first.

tools.name: search_macro_views
tools.description: Individual macro themes and drivers from provider research (growth, inflation, policy, fiscal, geopolitics, …), each with a description and a link to the source publication. Items come in pages (offset / next_offset), spread across providers by default. For counts and trends, call summarize_views fi

tools.name: search_research
tools.description: Research publications (articles, reports, podcasts) with title, provider, date, a short description and the link to the original. Ranked by how well the terms match (title matches count most), then newest; pages via offset / next_offset. Follow the link for the full text where the publisher allows i

tools.name: get_daily_digests
tools.description: The Daily Digest: one synthesis per day per category (e.g. gold, oil, us_bonds, top macro themes, policy_makers), written from all providers' views that day — the read, why, sub-splits, individual names, where providers appear to disagree — with the day's code-computed tallies, structured highlights

tools.name: get_policy_signals
tools.description: Structured reads of central-bank and multilateral publications: decisions, stance (-2 dovish to +2 hawkish), guidance, conditions, speaker and forecasts, each with a link to the original. Newest first; pages via offset / next_offset.

tools.name: get_investment_themes
tools.description: FinChiefs' Investment Themes board: the durable themes research houses argue, each an opportunity or a risk, with one vote per house (for / against / mixed), agreement, change in houses, the newest views, tactical vs longer-term tallies, flags (where houses agree, contrarian minorities), what could

tools.name: get_theme
tools.description: One Investment Theme by slug: its thesis, tally, horizons and flags, every research house's stance with its latest note and source link, the instruments the research names (by 2+ houses; not selected or endorsed by FinChiefs), positioning and related themes. Slugs come from get_investment_themes.

tools.name: get_yield_curves
tools.description: Government bond yield curves for the US (Treasury), euro area (ECB AAA curve), UK (Bank of England) and Japan (Ministry of Finance): yields per tenor now, a day, a month and a year ago, the 2s10s and 3m10y spreads, and optionally weekly 2y / 10y / 2s10s history. Official data with its source.

tools.name: get_policy_rates
tools.description: Policy rates of the Fed, ECB, BoE, BoJ, Bank of Canada, RBA, SNB and PBoC: current rate, last change, moves in the past 12 months and the rate path since a date; plus the FOMC dot-plot medians (latest and previous release) when the Fed is included. Official data (BIS, ECB, Federal Reserve). Market-i

tools.name: get_central_bank_meetings
tools.description: Each central bank's next rate decision (and decisions of the past week): date, FinChiefs' preview, the research tally (one hike/hold/cut vote per research house — banks, asset managers, independent research firms and podcasts — counted from published notes) with its mix by house type, and the outcom

tools.name: get_positioning
tools.description: Weekly speculative positioning in futures: CFTC Commitments of Traders for US-listed FX, rates, equity-index, energy, metals, agricultural and bitcoin futures, and ESMA's MiFID II reports for Dutch TTF gas. Net position, % of open interest, week change, 52/156-week COT index, crowding, other trader

tools.name: get_economic_indicators
tools.description: Economic indicators for the US, euro area, UK and Japan from official sources (statistics offices, central banks, OECD, FRED): inflation, growth, labour market, financial conditions, money and credit, housing, public finances, currencies, expectations surveys. Latest print with its period, change, s

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_daily_digests" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Daily summaries written from all providers' views for a category (e.g. gold, oil, us_bonds, top macro themes, policy makers), with the day's up/down tallies. Good for how a view changed day by day. Category keys (has_daily_digest) come from list_categories." → after: "The Daily Digest: one synthesis per day per category (e.g. gold, oil, us_bonds, top macro themes, policy_makers), written from all providers' views that day — the read, why, sub-splits, individual names, where providers appear to disagree — with the day's code-computed tallies, structured highlights"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
